description: Comptages des VAE et bicloo par Place au vélo à Nantes - Années 2010 à 2026 is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Place au vélo. Comptages des VAE et des bicloo à Nantes par Place au vélo de 2010 à 2025. Issues des campagnes annuelles de comptages de Place au vélo, les informations sur le nombre de VAE (Vélos à Assistance Électrique) et de bicloo (Vélos en Libre Service à Nantes Métropole) sont comptabilisées. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Place au vélo, vélo, Comptage, VAE, bicloo. The portal shows 340 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
